verdicts.rationale: Both halves confirmed. (a) has_equations is built from _detect_math_fonts / _detect_equations / has_corrupt_math (born_digital.py:814-816) and omits has_unmapped_math_glyphs; the agentic equation gate admits a page only if pa.has_equations, so a STIXGeneral+PUA page never enters detection even with both flags on. verdicts.rationale: Root cause confirmed by reading; the reporter's page measurements were not re-run. _MATH_FONT_RE (born_digital.py:38-43) is a closed whitelist of TeX/STIX/OTF-math families - CMMI|CMSY|CMEX|MSAM|MSBM|STIXMath|...|Euler|rsfs - with no Pazo, PazoMath, URWPalladioL or MathPazo entry. detect_display_equations builds its math_font_names set purely by running that regex over span fonts (detect_equations.py:220) and then requires DISPLAY_MIN_MATH_SPAN_RATIO = 0.50 of a line's characters to come from such spans (line 90), so the reported ratios of 0.04 and 0.00 discard every region. I did not reproduce the BHL_2026 p.6 numbers - no fixture in-tree and no PDF available to this seat - so the blast-radius claim rests on the reporter. The night-sized fix is the reporter's item 3: flag the disagreement when the page-level math predicate fires and the region detector returns zero regions, plus the whitelist extension as mitigation. The glyph-identity redesign (item 1) is a larger piece.
